Open Google Chat in the box browser and see if Tyson is already signed in. Goal: learn how Tyson Goulding writes in Google Chat.

1. Go directly to https://chat.google.com (or https://mail.google.com/chat/u/0/ if that redirects).
2. If you hit a Google login/SSO/2FA wall, STOP immediately. Report: not signed in, what the login screen says, and do not type any password or 2FA.
3. If already signed in, confirm the account email (should be tyson.goulding@optconnect.com). If it's a different account, report that and stop.
4. Do NOT send, edit, or delete any messages.
5. Collect a writing sample of messages Tyson himself sent: open several recent DMs and a few spaces/rooms. Copy his own message text verbatim (short quotes), note whether each was a DM or a space, and roughly how recent. Aim for 25-40 of HIS messages across different conversations. Skip other people's messages except as tiny context.
6. Report back: signed-in or not; account email; list of conversations you opened; the verbatim samples grouped DM vs space; any obvious style notes. If a step needs the user (login), say so and stop.
I'll start by opening Google Chat.
